title: Product Showcase Budget Allocator
description: Users manage a virtual product showcase with a fixed 'spotlight energy' budget of 100 units distributed between two products: an organic Avocado food item and a DamagedHelmet tech accessory. Adjusting one product's spotlight intensity, pedestal height, rotation speed, scale, and glow color simultaneously affects the other product's allocations through conservation coupling. Full undo/redo history tracks every adjustment.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a dual-product showcase allocator. Load Avocado.glb on the left pedestal and DamagedHelmet.glb on the right pedestal. Both sit on cylindrical pedestals with metallic material. Use a dark gradient background with a ground plane featuring subtle grid lines. Add OrbitControls for camera navigation, starting at position (0, 2, 6) looking at origin. Use HDR-style lighting with one ambient light and two SpotLights, one per product. Implement a conservation system: a total budget of 100 energy units shared across 5 coupled parameters per product — spotlight intensity (0-100), pedestal height (0-5 units), rotation speed (0-2 rad/s), model scale (0.5-2.0), and emissive glow strength (0-1). Display sliders in an HTML overlay panel on the left side for the Avocado and right side for the DamagedHelmet. When any slider for one product increases by N, the corresponding slider on the other product must decrease by N (conservation law). The total across both products for each parameter pair must remain constant at its initial combined value. Show a master budget bar at the top displaying total allocated energy (sum of all 10 slider values normalized). Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y, storing snapshots of all 10 parameter values on every slider change. Display an undo/redo step counter. Add a 'Reset All' button that restores defaults (50/50 split). Each product should continuously rotate at its assigned speed. Pedestal height animates smoothly via lerp. Emissive glow applies a colored emissive material override tinted green for Avocado and orange for DamagedHelmet. Ensure at least 10-14 meaningful interaction steps are possible: adjusting 5 sliders per product, undo, redo, reset, orbit camera, and clicking a product to auto-maximize its allocation.
